title: Coalitional influence under monotonization
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a function from the $n$-dimensional sign cube to the signs, let $J$ be a set of coordinates, and let $b$ be a sign. The coalitional influence of the coordinatewise monotonization of $f$ toward $b$ is at most the coalitional influence of $f$ toward $b$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
$J$ is a finite set of coordinates
